jars: In your own words, what you are doing today. Let her see your real self, not a perfect version. (This ignores the reality that a 6-year-old doesn't need a corporate breakdown of your PM duties)
The pride you feel in your career is lanced for your good
Janaka was known as the wisest king, yet he broke when his daughter left (This is a very specific and potentially confusing narrative for someone who has never read the Ramcharitmanas)
best: You are not two separate halves. When you hold your daughter, you are also holding yourself.
day1_verdict: This actually names my exact feeling of being split, but the 'do your own work' advice feels a bit too simplistic for a 34-year-old startup PM juggling in-laws and two toddlers.
